title: Polonia insta a la UE a multar con 250 millones de euros a Meta por estafas y anuncios falsos
summary: Polonia solicitó a la Comisión Europea imponer una multa de 250 millones de euros a Meta Platforms, acusando a la compañía de no atender adecuadamente los anuncios fraudulentos en sus plataformas. La petición se suma a la presión regulatoria europea sobre las grandes tecnológicas por publicidad engañosa y protección al consumidor.

title: Alphabet Loses $692 Billion in Market Value as AI Questions Rise
summary: Alphabet has shed $692 billion in market value after being seen for much of the past year as the Big Tech stock best positioned to win from the AI boom. Investors are now raising fresh questions about whether that leadership position is as secure as assumed.

title: Credit Default Swap Market Surges as AI Spend Booms
summary: As Big Tech races toward trillions of dollars in planned AI capital spending, credit default swap markets are showing signs of stress, a key indicator of rising credit-risk perception. The move suggests investors are starting to price in the financing risk behind the AI infrastructure buildout.

title: Nvidia acuerda comprar Hugging Face por 12,900 millones de dólares: The Information
summary: Nvidia acordó comprar Hugging Face, el popular repositorio de modelos de IA de código abierto, por 12,900 millones de dólares, según reportó The Information citando una fuente cercana al acuerdo. De concretarse, sería una de las mayores adquisiciones de Nvidia y reforzaría su control sobre la infraestructura del ecosistema de inteligencia artificial abierta.

title: Bain Fund Buys Stake in Clearing Broker RQD* Amid Options Boom
summary: Bain Capital is taking an equity stake in stock and options intermediary RQD* Clearing, joining a wave of new capital flowing into clearing and custody markets. The deal reflects growing private-equity interest in the infrastructure behind the options trading boom.

title: Is AI making workers more vulnerable?
summary: A new study may offer the clearest evidence yet linking AI adoption to employer decisions to rethink or eliminate roles, an area where hard data on job displacement has been scarce. The findings feed a broader debate over how much of current labor-market softness is attributable to AI rather than other cyclical factors.

title: La construcción hoy depende de la obra pública
summary: La construcción en México muestra señales de recuperación, con un crecimiento de 6.9% anual en junio según el INEGI, pero el impulso proviene casi enteramente de la obra pública: agua y saneamiento crecieron 303%, ferrocarriles 250% y electricidad 82%. En contraste, la inversión privada cayó 1.1% y la construcción residencial retrocedió 5.4% pese al programa nacional de vivienda.

title: Human Reviewers Need Support to Keep AI Models From Going Rogue
summary: AI lab staff tasked with reviewing model behavior need stronger backing from leadership to catch problems before they reach users, according to the piece. Without that support, human oversight processes meant to prevent AI models from acting unpredictably risk becoming a weak link.

title: Shein Set to Raise $1.7 Billion in Hong Kong IPO
summary: Shein is on track to raise about $1.7 billion in its Hong Kong IPO, likely pricing just above the midpoint of its marketed range. The listing would value the fast-fashion retailer at just above $26 billion, a steep discount to the roughly $100 billion valuation it commanded four years ago.

title: UBS Nudging Swiss Capital Debate Toward a Cheaper Compromise
summary: Swiss lawmakers are coalescing around a possible compromise on UBS Group's capital regulation that could lower the cost of meeting the government's $20 billion capital demand. The shift suggests the long-running standoff over how much extra capital UBS must hold may be easing toward a cheaper resolution.

title: Camacol propone un régimen especial de vivienda y la devolución del IVA tras el terremoto
summary: Camacol propuso al gobierno colombiano un régimen especial de vivienda y un esquema nacional de bancos de materiales para la reconstrucción tras el terremoto del 10 de agosto, inspirado en el modelo VIVA de Antioquia. El gremio constructor busca replicar a escala nacional una plataforma que ya mostró resultados en la provisión de insumos para vivienda social y atención de emergencias.

title: Retail atrae marcas internacionales
summary: Doce marcas internacionales se establecieron en el primer semestre del año en centros comerciales de CDMX, Guadalajara, Monterrey, Los Cabos y Riviera Maya, según CBRE México, en categorías de lujo, moda, gastronomía y bienestar. El reporte destaca que mientras algunos formatos tradicionales muestran señales de moderación, las categorías de mayor valor mantienen resiliencia ante un consumidor más selectivo.

title: Nvidia forecasts 70% sales growth fuelled by relentless AI boom
summary: Nvidia forecast sales growth of roughly 70% for the coming year, beating Wall Street expectations and reinforcing confidence that AI infrastructure spending has further to run. The chipmaker also pushed back against growing criticism of 'circular financing' arrangements underpinning some of its AI deals.

title: Gran prueba para el GNL argentino: buscan financiamiento por US$17.000 millones entre bancos globales
summary: Dos proyectos de exportación de gas natural licuado de Vaca Muerta —Argentina LNG (YPF, Eni, XRG) y Southern Energy (PAE, YPF, Pampa Energía, Harbour Energy, Golar LNG)— avanzan en negociaciones para levantar en conjunto cerca de US$17,000 millones con bancos internacionales. Argentina LNG evalúa un paquete de deuda de hasta US$16,000 millones, mientras Southern Energy está cerca de cerrar US$900 millones.

title: Germany Running Short of AI Compute Capacity, Minister Says
summary: Germany's top digital policy official said surging AI demand is straining data-center capacity in Europe's largest economy. The shortage highlights how compute availability is becoming a bottleneck for AI adoption even in advanced economies.

title: Stripe Says AI Helps Asian Firms Expand Globally at Record Pace
summary: Stripe says AI tools are letting Asian businesses expand into new international markets faster than ever before, according to comments from its Southeast Asia managing director. The company frames AI adoption as a key driver behind record-pace global expansion among its regional merchants.

title: Cheap Tokens, Costly Chips and a Missing AI Payoff
summary: The price of running AI models is falling fast even as the cost of building the underlying chip infrastructure keeps climbing. Equity investors spent the summer trying to figure out who — labs, cloud providers, or chipmakers — ends up absorbing that gap.

title: US Probes Singapore Firm Over Alleged Nvidia Chip Smuggling
summary: US authorities are investigating Singapore-based Apex Logistics over its suspected role in smuggling Nvidia AI chips to China, in what could become the first enforcement action against a transportation company for alleged semiconductor-export violations. The probe reflects intensifying US efforts to police AI chip export controls.

title: US Says China-Linked Hackers Targeted NASA, Fed and Senate
summary: The US Justice Department said it disrupted online infrastructure allegedly used by Chinese state-sponsored hackers to target NASA, the Federal Reserve, the Senate, and other government agencies and critical infrastructure. The case underscores escalating state-backed cybersecurity threats against core financial and government institutions.

title: Gobernadora de Banxico: futuro de la tasa dependerá de valoración del panorama inflacionario
summary: La gobernadora de Banxico, Victoria Rodríguez Ceja, dijo que la postura monetaria del banco central no está predeterminada y que el nivel futuro de la tasa de interés dependerá de la evaluación que haga la Junta de Gobierno sobre el panorama inflacionario. La declaración deja abierta la puerta tanto a pausas como a nuevos movimientos en la tasa de referencia.

title: Kioxia, Sandisk Plan $31 Billion Japan Memory Chip Expansion
summary: Kioxia and Sandisk plan to spend more than ¥5 trillion ($31.4 billion) to expand memory chip production capacity in Japan. The investment targets a critical AI data-center component that is currently in short supply amid the broader AI infrastructure buildout.

title: Meta settles its blockbuster trial for up to $17bn
summary: Meta has agreed to settle a blockbuster trial for up to $17 billion, resolving claims tied to how its platforms affect teenage users. The settlement will require the company to change how teens can use Facebook and Instagram, though the changes reportedly apply only to US users for now.

title: Arte Abierto / Sordo Madaleno Arquitectos
summary: Arte Abierto Baja has opened in Los Cabos, a new open-air public art gallery designed by Sordo Madaleno at Ánima Village. The project brings Mexican and international artists into dialogue with the Baja California Sur landscape.

title: BTG Pactual ve 10 oportunidades para crear valor en Ecopetrol, pero su nuevo presidente será clave
summary: BTG Pactual identifica diez palancas de creación de valor para Ecopetrol, pero advierte que aprovecharlas dependerá de quién asuma la presidencia de la petrolera tras la salida de Ricardo Roa, sucesión aún sin resolver. La firma mantiene una recomendación Neutral sobre la acción mientras el mercado espera claridad sobre el liderazgo.

title: El Trebol House / Engelman Estudio
summary: Casa El Trébol sits at the highest point of its namesake neighborhood in San Carlos de Bariloche, Argentine Patagonia, set within a dense native forest on a steep slope. Engelman Estudio designed the house as a processional route through the forest that culminates in framed views of Laguna El Trébol.

title: Gobierno de Milei anuncia medida para impulsar créditos hipotecarios con fondos del FGS
summary: El ministro de Economía argentino, Luis Caputo, anunció un programa de licitación de plazos fijos con fondos del FGS para acelerar el crédito hipotecario en el país, buscando un 'efecto multiplicador' en otros sectores de la economía. Caputo reconoció que el fondeo bancario de corto plazo ha dificultado históricamente los préstamos a 20-25 años en Argentina.

title: Jane Street's growing pains
summary: Jane Street, the notoriously secretive trading firm, may need to change how it operates as its size and risk appetite continue to grow. The piece frames the firm's expansion as testing the limits of the low-profile model that built its success.

title: Junior consultants called back to office as AI increases need for human skills
summary: Executives say AI has made interpersonal and human skills more valuable, prompting firms to call junior consultants back into the office. The shift suggests AI adoption is reshaping which skills organizations prioritize in early-career talent rather than simply automating their work.
